title: 🔆🔅 TEHRAN, October 3rd — Ali Khezrian, a member of the Iranian Parliament's National Security Commission, made remarks.
text:
🔆🔅 TEHRAN, October 3rd — Ali Khezrian, a member of the Iranian Parliament's National Security Commission, made remarks."

"SOT1, Ali Khezrian, Member of Iranian Parliament's National Security Commission: "The enemy's assessment is that within the next two weeks it could first undermine our resilience on other fronts. The Zionist regime is seeking this, and the Americans are seeking this — to trigger an internal uprising in our country. As a member of the National Security Commission, I state that our security, intelligence, and law enforcement agencies are fully aware of this issue and have made arrests in this regard; they will not allow anyone to take action in the streets against this important achievement of the third imposed war in a way that violates national security.""

"SOT2, "A week ago, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said that the Iranian economy would collapse within the next two weeks. Well, a week has passed. If our officials act correctly, including on the foreign-exchange issue, and if there is no dumping of currency into non-essential goods — if they can properly implement these currency controls in the Iranian economy — then even this past week, and even these economic fluctuations, are due to that psychological warfare, not to any real impact on the ground. Therefore, we believe that the current conditions are not heading toward an economic collapse.""

"SOT3, "Zionists are seeking to involve the Americans in a military conflict; the Zionist lobby is active in this matter, as are those around Trump. Trump has lost a war and does not want to exit under these circumstances. The path is completely clear. The Islamic Republic of Iran has announced certain conditions; these conditions must be met so they can leave here with dignity. The Islamic Republic of Iran will not create a window for a dignified exit for anyone under these circumstances unless our national interests are secured.""

"SOT4, "In many sectors of food production, under the guidance of our martyred Imam [Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei], we are producers rather than importers, and we are capable of meeting our own needs. Therefore, our resilience regarding essential commodities is in a completely favorable condition. According to reports from the government and the Minister of Agriculture, the country's foreign-exchange situation is also favorable; we have been able to sell our oil, and we continue to do so.""

"SOT5, "The enemy's miscalculation, plus actions by the Zionist regime, could provide grounds for a confrontation, which we have also predicted. In this regard, our country will not face problems with resilience; our people should know this. Our dear country and officials have made plans such that if they want to start this war — which is what we predict they will do, as their regional posture tells us — it is not secret news that they are doing this. Under these circumstances, resilience for our country will not be a problem.
